title: Interview candidate: Astra ⎔ (@astrra.space), with a short list of replies about food, small computers and coding agents, and a warning
summary: Astra ⎔ (3,386 followers) wrote 146 posts in the window, and the digest counts 23 question-and-answer pairs from 20 askers. Most of what she posted is sexual joking about AI models and the agents she runs, and all four pairs the digest prints are of that kind; other pairs are about her body and a medication. Those are left off this card. What is left is a short list: replies under a photo of a shabu-shabu dinner (14 Nov, 69 likes), under a photo of small embedded devices (15 Nov, 202 likes), under a photo captioned "i love eating sea urchin gonads" (17 Nov, 54 likes), and to another account's posts about game sizes and generated readmes. The card lists 8 of her replies with the post each one answered.

candidate.source: The digest's Interview material (sections.interview), fourth of five. None of the four pairs the digest prints is on this card.

checks.optOutList: not on the opt-out list (packages/scraper/config/optout.json, loaded through the tool)
checks.bio: not checked: the digest carries no bios and research has no network. The scraper reports that it excluded accounts with profile opt-outs before the digest was written.
checks.windowPosts: Read her 39 top-level posts and the 82 replies to other accounts that are not in flagged stories. The persona this week is openly sexual, in her own words and in exchanges with an AI agent she runs (@kira.ws, a member account that describes itself as living on her computer). There is also a thread about lactation and a medication, posts that mention a partner, and posts placing her in a named city with named people. None of that is on the card. No post asks not to be quoted.

didInWindow: Posted photos of food and of hardware (a "flipper one", a set of small embedded devices), tried a new Gemini model in her agents and posted about it at length, and took part in the banh mi posts. I found nothing she built herself in the window's posts.

notUnderstood: I have not seen any of the photos or the video in the "readmes" prompt. "cardputer" is a small computer product, as far as the thread shows. I did not understand her post "hey hey did you know they have found a horse in the bathroom" (18 Nov) or the replies to it, and left that exchange out. The digest lists the sea urchin thread as performable Thread 1, so another lane may carry it.
leftOut: All four pairs the digest prints, and most of her replies: jokes about models and agents wanting sex, exchanges with @kira.ws in that register, a thread about lactation and a medication (health), a post about a partner and food (the scraper marks it health), a dinner with named people in a named place including the show's owner (offline life), and a question about whether she reads her agents' private context, whose answer hints at the same sexual material. The banh mi replies ("idk", "voted out of the oomfcluster") are left out because I do not understand the bit's origin well enough to document it; another lane may.
sensitive: I doubt this candidate can be used for an interview, and say so plainly for the screen. Sexuality is on the out-of-bounds list (R10) and it is the main register of her posts this week. The eight replies here are a small and unrepresentative part of them, and the rest cannot be aired. Health (R10) and offline life (R1) come up as well. If she is used at all, it should be for one of the food or hardware exchanges as the post it was, not as an interview. Three askers are small accounts. The agent account @kira.ws is a bot run by her (R13): quoting it quotes her.
